summary: Master Blockchain Technology and its Applications in Central Banking. Learn CBDC design, DLT architecture, and ISO 20022 integration for modern finance.
lede: Blockchain for central banks examines how distributed ledgers can support digital currencies, settlement and payment infrastructure. Designed for central-bank economists, payment-system analysts and digital-currency professionals, it addresses the practical task of evaluating these systems through comparison of retail and wholesale CBDC models, assessment of consensus and network governance, and development of cross-border settlement flows.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals tasked with the digital evolution of national and international financial infrastructures.
modules: Foundations of DLT in Central Banking
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of central banking operations, payment systems, and basic financial technology concepts. Prior experience in policy analysis, economics, or IT infrastructure within a financial institution is highly recommended. No advanced coding skills are required, but familiarity with digital asset terminology is beneficial.
